description: Name + role lower third: an accent bar grows, a dark glass panel wipes out of it, the name rises letter by letter and the role slides in. Reverses out. Transparent background.

params.name: Person's name (one line, auto-fit)
params.role: Role / title / handle under the name (optional)
params.position: 'left' (default), 'right' or 'center' — horizontal placement in the lower area
params.accent2: Second gradient colour for the bar (hex), default #22D3EE
params.panel: 'glass' (default, dark translucent panel) or 'none' (text only, with shadow)
params.background: Solid background used only for opaque .mp4 output, default #0B0B10
